A widget can implement this method to return custom margin inset values to use instead of the default values specified in .

(If the widget doesn’t need to use custom values, it should return the unchanged default values in its implementation.) If a widget doesn’t implement this method, it automatically receives the default margin inset values.
Called to let a widget accept the default margin inset values or return custom values to use instead.
